SERV-CT.reason: EPE worsens by 0.0561 px, false-update is 38.41%, clean degradation 22.69%, and 64.29% of evaluated frames worsen.

SCARED_structured_light_keyframes.scope: static-repeat direct-GT preservation, not temporal improvement
SCARED_structured_light_keyframes.reason: The native-grid EPE change is -0.0106 px (raw minus refined), with 0.71% false-update and 0.68% clean degradation. The 15.58 px native-grid maximum update and 62.22% tiny frame-level worsening require an explicit tail warning.

D4D_structured_light_anchors.reason: Mean EPE improves by 0.0494 px, but Bad3 worsens, false-update is 29.15%, clean degradation 17.95%, worst-frame degradation 2.55 px, and specimen_2/specimen_3 do not improve.

D4D_temporal_sequences.scope: four-frame no-reference windows plus final-anchor GT
D4D_temporal_sequences.reason: Motion-compensated temporal error improves by 0.1068 px, but intervention coverage is 42.20% and the corresponding anchor geometry fails safety. This is temporal smoothing without safe geometric transfer.

StereoMIS.reason: Across 38,238 transitions, intervention is sparse and bounded, but aggregate temporal error worsens by 0.00149 px; P2_8 and P3 worsen and only P1 improves slightly. No geometric claim is possible without GT.

overall.paper_recommendation: GO for reporting the completed controlled experiments; NO-GO for claiming general cross-dataset safety or deployment readiness.
overall.reason: Backbone transfer succeeds within SCARED, but cross-dataset calibration fails on SERV-CT and D4D, and no-reference StereoMIS temporal consistency is not improved.
